description: Defines the LoanDisbursementDetails entity class for managing loan disbursement information, including dates, principal, amount, and reversal status.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing details of a loan disbursement, including dates, principal, amount, and reversal status.

methods.name: updateLoan
methods.description: Associates a Loan object with this disbursement detail.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare disbursement details based on principal and expected disbursement date.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on expected disbursement date and principal.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LoanDisbursementDetails instance.

methods.name: expectedDisbursementDateAsLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the expected disbursement date as LocalDate, or null if not set.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a DisbursementData object.

methods.name: updateExpectedDisbursementDateAndAmount
methods.description: Updates expected disbursement date and principal.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Checks if the disbursement has been reversed.
